about_the_game:
Looking for a relaxing game after a tough day at school, work, or just existing? Then look further, because this may not be for you!

In Throwing Knight, you’ll launch yourself like a trebuchet projectile, fail 567 times, and then finally land a perfect jump—just to fall into the next pit. A brutally challenging platformer where every move is controlled entirely with your mouse—drag, aim, and pray for the best!

Test your temper across four levels, each with unique obstacles and atmosphere. Use your mouse to control direction and strength of the jump. Swing on physics-based chains to overcome greater distances. Avoid every trap designed with only one goal: to kill you.

Pick up the potions to get needful lives when you reach the checkpoint. Find out the time and number of deaths it took to finally complete the level, and try to bring those numbers down on your next attempt. Have fun and don’t get too mad. GIT GUD !

Do you believe you’ve got what it takes? Then prove it – ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST NOW!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics / Nvidia GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Intel High Definition Audio.

short_description: Mouse-operated precision platformer with intentionally awkward controls. Set direction and force of the jump with one mouse drag. Stay calm, git gud !
